issues.description: Console log shows a 400 error from a failed resource load, likely an auth-related API call or asset fetch. The page:mount event fires for 'auth' page repeatedly even while on the landing page, suggesting a background prefetch or redirect logic hitting a bad endpoint.
issues.element: Console: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400'
issues.root_cause: An API call or image/font resource is returning 400. Likely in an auth-related component or a prefetch in the root layout. Could be a Supabase auth session check or an image URL with missing/invalid parameters.

issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This is a scroll-related positioning warning.
issues.root_cause: A scroll utility or parallax component references a container element that has default static positioning. The SCROLL indicator or hero section container likely lacks position: relative.
